// GREEN fixture for `no-cross-sync-cycle` — the lint MUST admit this.
// @identity-sink
// Identity reacts to other services ONLY over the bus (an emit / an EventHandler), never a sync
// call back. The sync call graph stays acyclic with Identity as the sink (EI-02 §3).
pub async fn react_over_bus(tx: &mut OutboxTx, draft: EventDraft, cause: Cause) {
    tx.emit(draft, cause).unwrap();
}
